challenge: Welcome to Cape San Blas! Monday's rest did its job, so today we ease back in on the sand: a 30–35 minute beach walk with 4 one-minute easy jogs on the firm sand by the waterline, then a 5-minute cool-down walk. It's clear and calm down there but heads to 82°F and humid, so go early evening around 5–6 PM ET, or first thing if you land early. If travel runs long or the cold's still hanging on, a plain 30-minute walk still counts.
constraint: Walks and runs only through Fri Oct 16.
